name: The Might of Kalimdor

chain: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands
The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain

summary: In Tanaris, Anachronos greets you in The Might of Kalimdor as the champion fate has awaited for a thousand years. He sees you leading your people into a new age. The Blue, Green and Red Scepter Shard forks are complete, bringing the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to its end.

sections.title: The Old God Trembles
sections.body: Anachronos speaks of a fate a thousand years in the making. The Old God trembles at your coming and fears your faith. Anachronos urges you to break C'Thun's prophecy, and you bring Kalimdor's strength with you. When you are ready, tell Anachronos, and he will place the Scepter of the Shifting Sands in your hands.

sections.title: Words of Parting
sections.body: Anachronos declares the Scepter of the Shifting Sands complete again. The scepter is yours alone to wield, and you are to lead your people into the age ahead. The Scarab Gong must wait: both the Horde and Alliance armies must first arrive in Silithus.

faq.q: Who offers The Might of Kalimdor?
aliases: who gives the might of kalimdor
faq.answer: Anachronos offers The Might of Kalimdor only after you finish all three Scepter Shard forks: Blue, Green and Red.

faq.q: What does the Old God fear?
aliases: who fears the might of kalimdor
faq.answer: Anachronos says the Old God C'Thun trembles at your coming and fears your faith. He urges you to shatter C'Thun's prophecy.

faq.q: What must be done before this step?
aliases: what do i need before might of kalimdor
faq.answer: Finish all three Scepter Shard forks first: the Blue, the Green and the Red.
